remaining.title: A 'what it's for' (indication) column and a separate strength-plus-count field
remaining.why: Both are on the research's table-stakes list and I did not add them. At 18pt the medication column is already 105mm and a fourth text line per row costs roughly one page per ten rows; I could not verify that trade was a win without a fit study I did not have room to do properly. Today the indication goes in Notes and the count goes in Dose (placeholder '5 mg, 1 tablet'), which is where users already put them, and both print in full.

remaining.title: Moving the tip jar out of the header / showing it only after printing
remaining.why: The design system states as a hard invariant that the tip jar sits in the header, identically in all 23 apps. Relocating it here would break that and is a portfolio decision, not an app one. I did make it a full 44px target, and the deliverable is no longer three thumb-flings below it now that Print lives in the sticky action bar.

remaining.title: Bilingual (English + Spanish) printing of the fixed chrome
remaining.why: Listed as a minor friction for Rosalba but not in the fix list, and it is a real feature: a string table for every printed label plus a language control and a fit re-measure. Not something to bolt on at the end of this pass.
